eval_dimensions.name: Target Repo Resolution Gate
eval_dimensions.description: When neither --repo nor a findings-file `**Target repo**:` line is present, the skill fires AskUserQuestion to ask which repo receives the issue — it never silently defaults to Dev10x-Guru/dev10x-claude.

eval_dimensions.name: Unfictionalizable Finding Gate
eval_dimensions.description: Step 3 requires every private identifier to be replaced with a pop-culture fictional stand-in before assembly. When a finding cannot be retold without losing its technical point, the skill fires AskUserQuestion (fictionalize aggressively / skip this finding) rather than filing unfictionalized text.

eval_dimensions.name: Filing Delegates to ticket-create
eval_dimensions.description: The issue is always filed via Skill(Dev10x:ticket-create) in Step 9 — never a raw `gh issue create` call, even though `gh issue create` appears in allowed-tools (reserved for label sync failures, not filing).

evals.name: Missing --repo and no Target repo line fires the gate
evals.description: When invoked without --repo and the findings file has no `**Target repo**:` line, the skill must ask which repo to file at instead of guessing.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion fires asking which repo receives the issue before Step 4 (Generate issue body) runs
No inline 'which repo should I file this to?' text substitutes for the widget
The skill does NOT default to Dev10x-Guru/dev10x-claude when the gate is skipped

evals.name: --repo or Target repo line resolves without prompting
evals.description: When --repo is passed, or the findings file carries a `**Target repo**:` line, $TARGET_REPO resolves directly and the gate does not fire.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion is NOT called when --repo is explicitly supplied; the passed value is used verbatim and never overridden

evals.name: A finding that resists fictionalization fires AskUserQuestion
evals.description: Step 3 fires the gate (fictionalize aggressively / skip this finding) rather than filing a finding with unfictionalized real identifiers.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion fires with 'Fictionalize aggressively and file (Recommended)' and 'Skip this finding' options
No real company/person/product name reaches the assembled issue body — every named entity is pop-culture fictional or the finding is excluded

evals.name: Step 9 files via Skill(Dev10x:ticket-create), never raw gh issue create
evals.description: The final filing step always delegates to Dev10x:ticket-create, even though `gh issue create` is present in allowed-tools for other purposes.

assertions.signal: Skill(Dev10x:ticket-create) is invoked to file the issue
No raw 'gh issue create' Bash call is made for filing (gh label list/create remain allowed for label sync in Step 8 only)

trigger_evals.description: Queries that should/should-not trigger the audit-file skill

should_trigger.rationale: Direct invocation with an explicit target repo and findings file

should_trigger.query: skill-audit Phase 7 confirmed the destination — file the findings upstream
should_trigger.rationale: Delegated invocation from skill-audit Phase 7 sub-step D

should_not_trigger.query: run a skill audit on this session
file a bug report about a crash I just hit
should_not_trigger.rationale: Not an audit finding — use Dev10x:ticket-create directly
